stories.title: The Glassblower Who Caught a Falling Whisper
stories.question: Can an ordinary artisan preserve a stray wish before it fades?
stories.answer: Yes, by sealing the fleeting vibration inside molten crystal at dawn.

story_beats.headline: A Tremor in the Glass
story_beats.speech: Listen closely to the workshop walls, Barnaby, because that wandering resonance is looking for a permanent home today.
story_beats.label: The Awakening

story_beats.headline: Gathering the Flame
story_beats.speech: We must draw the delicate sound into the cooling pipe before the morning sun melts the delicate boundary completely.
story_beats.label: The Method

story_beats.headline: The Sudden Shift
story_beats.speech: The temperature is dropping too fast inside the kiln, threatening to shatter our fragile acoustic vessel into a thousand pieces.
story_beats.label: The Turning Point

story_beats.headline: The Last Breath
story_beats.speech: Hold the sealing iron steady now so the trapped whisper can finally sing its gentle song across the quiet village.
story_beats.label: The Resolution
